# A shaded place to sort seedlings

The chairs under the tree are now where people trade seedling advice. We added a low table, which made the path narrower for the walker. Moved the table after asking two people to pass each other. [[Garden notebook]]: a welcoming addition can exclude someone through its placement. The photograph needs people in it, with their permission.
